title: Infrastructure Overview
description: Start here. Green is healthy, orange needs attention, red is critical or offline.

options.content: Green is healthy. Orange needs a look. Red means a resource is nearly full, a service has failed, or the server is offline. Open a server name for memory, disk, network, and what to check next. Container CPU and memory are not on this dashboard because cAdvisor is not installed.

panels.title: Server health
panels.description: One row per server. Health is Healthy when CPU, memory, and disk are under 80%, swap is under 50%, and load is within CPU capacity. Warning means one of those is high. Critical means a resource is over 90% or a service has failed. Offline means Node Exporter cannot be scraped. Disk is the fullest data filesystem, excluding the small EFI partition. Open a server name for detail.

panels.title: Current problems
panels.description: A row appears only when a live check is outside its limit. Reading is the current measurement: a percent for CPU, memory, disk, and swap; a ratio for load; a count for services and processes; errors per second for the network; days for a disk that is filling. An empty table means none of these checks are failing.
